# volcenginecc_cloudmonitor_aggregation_policy (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::CloudMonitor::AggregationPolicy



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `aggregations` (Attributes Set) List of aggregation rules configured by alert level (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregations))
- `associated_attributes` (Attributes Set) Associated attributes. RuleIDs: list of associated alert strategy IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_attributes))
- `create_time` (Number) Creation time, Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
- `created_by` (String) Creator
- `description` (String) Description of alert aggregation strategy.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default aggregation strategy.
- `name` (String) Alert aggregation policy name
- `resource_id` (String) Alert aggregation strategy ID.
- `type` (String) Aggregation strategy type. custom: custom; bound: bound to alert strategy (1:1).
- `update_time` (Number) Update time, Unix timestamp in milliseconds
- `updated_by` (String) Updated by.

<a id="nestedatt--aggregations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregations`

Read-Only:

- `group_by` (Set of String) Alert group fields, default [rule_id+region]. Currently only supports: 1. rule_id+region grouping, i.e., default grouping by severity. 2. Any rule_id+region+* grouping, i.e., each faulty resource forms a separate group, notification cycle is not affected by other faulty resources; in this mode, GroupWait/GroupInterval are not effective, default is 0. 3. rule_id+region+keys grouping based on actual alert group fields, grouped by key match and value. For example, rule_id+region+namespace+cluster+pod, each namespace+cluster+pod combination forms a separate group, notification cycle is not affected by other faulty resources; this method requires configuring a fallback aggregation strategy.
- `group_interval` (Number) Alert group wait interval for the 2nd to Nth times, in seconds, range is 5 seconds to 24 hours. If there is a new alert or recovery in the alert group, send immediately after GroupInterval and recalculate RepeatInterval.
- `group_wait` (Number) Alert group initial wait time, in seconds, range is 5 seconds to 24 hours. If not specified, defaults to GroupInterval.
- `level` (String) Alert severity, supports p0/p1/p2/all. all indicates the fallback aggregation strategy, meaning alerts are aggregated without distinguishing severity, but messages are still sent separately by severity. If not all p0/p1/p2 levels are configured, the "all" fallback strategy must be configured.
- `repeat_downgrade` (Attributes) Notification frequency reduction configuration. Note: P0 does not support notification frequency reduction, while P1/P2 do. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregations--repeat_downgrade))
- `repeat_interval` (Number) Alert repeat notification interval, in seconds, range is 1 minute to 24 hours.

<a id="nestedatt--aggregations--repeat_downgrade"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregations.repeat_downgrade`

Read-Only:

- `enable` (Boolean) Enable notification frequency reduction.
- `max_repeat_interval` (Number) Maximum repeat send interval, in seconds. Frequency reduction stops when this value is exceeded. Default is 24 hours (86400 seconds).
- `mode` (String) Frequency reduction mode, currently only supports doubled. doubled means each time the frequency is reduced, the repeat send interval is multiplied by 2 until MaxRepeatInterval.



<a id="nestedatt--associated_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `associated_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Attribute name. CloudMonitor supports Namespace, SubNamespace; VMP supports WorkspaceID; Cloud probe supports DetectTaskID; APMPlus Server supports ServiceName, Workspace; APMPlus Client TBD.
- `values` (Set of String) List of attribute values.
